svg.text: Sketch, not data: floors, rooms, bridges, tunnels and wrecks, and roughly how big. +X (right) is east, north is up. Every number is tunable in content data.
Not to scale for distances. Giant ~1.2–1.4× the home planet.
fly in: gas fog + packed rocks
no wall, you crash and die
Tall floors (~14 m), the top one biggest and each one below smaller. Open space (~12 m) between floors: the elevator crosses it in a glass tube. Tunnels join the towers at every level they share.
~76 m across, the port pit's size
drop hatch: 12 m down to wreck 1 (panel below)
Below the station: three wrecked cruisers in the belt

The desert wreck's 600 m hull (about 96 m wide, 76 m tall), three of them end to end like stairs. Every joint: the next hull's top is 12 m lower, across a 4 m gap, so you can jetpack down AND back up (a jump plus a full tank peaks at ~17 m). Same droids and prize crate on each.
drop hatch: 12 m down to wreck 1, jetpack back up
or fly down and land on wreck 1
fall off any wreck into the belt: dead
One joint, close up (any of the three, and the hatch)
jump 0.6 m, pack lights after 0.18 s, rises at up to 9 m/s for 1.8 s of fuel (content/core/items/jetpack.json)
Main tower: 4 floors, top to bottom

One scale for all floors: the top floor is the biggest, each one below smaller. Every floor: elevator in the open middle, 2 bridges to it, an inner walkway round the gap, then the rooms on the outside with big windows onto space.
N-S bridges · general + honour guard on the bridge
N-S bridges · stalls + grey metal huts, no rooms
Second tower: 3 floors, top to bottom
Smaller than the main tower, and also shrinking downward. Its floors line up with the main tower's floors 4, 3 and 2, and a tunnel joins each pair.
E-W bridges · stalls + grey metal huts
bridge to the elevator (2 per floor, alternating N-S / E-W)
inner walkway round the gap (doors open off it), corridors
windows: the rooms' outer wall, facing space
open home: bed, kitchen, lounge, 2–3 people
Floors are counted from the bottom (1) up.
Tunnels: main 4 to T2 homes, main 3 to T2 outpost,
main 2 to T2 markets. The bay's tunnel leaves
the main market floor to the west.
